response.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT s.telescref AS telescope, o.weathprofile AS weathprofile, s.modindex AS modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg AS phaseshiftdeg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation), grp AS (SELECT telescope, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase FROM linked GROUP BY telescope, weathprofile), base AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS baseline FROM grp), kept AS (SELECT g.*, b.baseline FROM grp g CROSS JOIN base b WHERE g.avg_mod > b.baseline) SELECT weathprofile, AVG(avg_mod) AS avg_modindex, AVG(avg_phase) AS avg_phaseshift, AVG(avg_mod - baseline) AS avg_excess_over_baseline FROM kept GROUP BY weathprofile

assumptions.assumption: Signals are linked by inner joins signals->telescopes->observatories, so signals without a matching telescope or observatory are dropped.

The baseline is the unweighted mean of all telescope/weather group average modulation indices (computed before filtering). The final 'average amount above baseline' is the mean of (group avg modindex - baseline) over the kept groups in each weather profile.
Null modulation index or phase shift values are ignored by AVG. A null weathprofile, if present, forms its own group and output row.
